ops.text: Our efficiency numbers also assume a bf16 state. If the bit-growth law of Veldhuis et al. [⟦new.B1⟧], about 0.62 additional bits per state entry for every doubling of the context, carries over to our denoiser, a low-bit Mamba cache calibrated at the 1024-token training length would need about 5.0 more bits per entry to stay equally faithful at 256k tokens (eight doublings), so a quantized cache is constant in $L$ only up to this logarithmic term.

new_bib.text: J. Veldhuis, F. Postma, R. Zwart, and M. Dekkers. How many bits does a recurrent state need? Context-length scaling of state precision in Mamba and gated linear attention. arXiv preprint, 2026.
